cards.title: Improve the room before the key

exchange.speaker: staff
exchange.es: Sí, tengo una lejos del elevador.
exchange.en: Yes, I have one far from the elevator.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: ¿Tiene una habitación en un piso alto?
exchange.en: Do you have a room on a high floor?

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: Is it possible to check out later tomorrow?

exchange.speaker: staff
exchange.es: Sí, hasta las dos, con un cargo adicional.
exchange.en: Yes, until two, with an additional charge.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: How much is the additional charge?

cards.title: Name the defect and get a checkpoint

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: The air conditioning does not work.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: What time can they check it?

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: Sigue sin funcionar. Necesito otra habitación, por favor.
exchange.en: It still doesn’t work. I need another room, please.

exchange.speaker: staff
exchange.es: Entiendo. Le voy a cambiar la habitación.
exchange.en: I understand. I’ll change your room.
